dedupe_keys.name: idb household mobility survey for the la paz and el alto integrated mass transit system mi teleferico cable car study 2015 6 720 residents 6 208 households last two trips each

description: The IDB published the household mobility survey collected in June and July 2015 for its project on an integrated public transport system in the metropolitan area of La Paz and El Alto, Bolivia, used in its study of travel time savings from the Mi Teleférico cable car network. Contents: 6,720 residents in 6,208 households (4,208 residents in La Paz, 2,512 in El Alto) sampled at block level across all districts, each reporting socioeconomic characteristics (sex, age band, occupation, education, income band, car ownership, perceived cable car safety and incidents) and their last two trips with origin and destination zones, mode, stations and times; the datastore table has 2,511 rows for one file, with trip and household files alongside. Producer: IDB Transport Division. Coverage: La Paz and El Alto, 2015. Format and access: two CSV files, an XLSX workbook and a DOCX data dictionary on IDB Open Data with a DOI; no registration. Licence: CC BY 4.0. Caveats: interviews were held from 6 to 9 p.m., so recalled trips are biased toward commuting patterns, and zone codes need the dictionary. Simulation uses: calibrating mode choice and origin-destination demand for urban transit and cable car network models, and evaluating access in high-altitude cities. Related records: the Latin American suburban passenger railway dataset (data-latin-american-suburban-passenger-railway-dataset) is another IDB transport dataset.
